**Who We Are**
In the past, to be a successful restaurateur, you simply had to have a passion for food and a passion for people — but to succeed as a digital restaurateur you also need to have a passion for technology. We believe in the joy of serving others, and that's why we created Otter – to help restaurateurs succeed in online food delivery. Restaurants around the world, both large and small, including Chick-fil-A, Ben & Jerry's, KFC, and Eataly trust our software to power their delivery business. We increase sales, reduce order issues, and decrease delivery headaches.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a Software Engineer on the Otter Customer Lifecycle team, you'll build the platform that every other team at Otter depends on — the core systems that define what a restaurant
*is*
in our product, and the services that get merchants from signup to serving orders.
  
  

* Build and own the merchant platform: the core services and data models behind stores, facilities, brands, and the entitlement-driven configuration that determines what each merchant can access.
* Design onboarding services that take a new restaurant from signup to live and serving orders, reliably and without manual intervention.
* Build the backend for self-serve growth — signup, activation, and conversion flows that let restaurants adopt Otter without touching a salesperson.
* Design offboarding and lifecycle cleanup so that when a merchant leaves, the systems behind them shut down cleanly instead of quietly running and costing money.
* Own your services end-to-end: design, build, instrument, debug, and improve reliability and performance.

**What We're Looking For**
We value diversity of experience and are looking for engineers excited to own complex, high-impact systems. We look for a strong sense of ownership — people ready to take their work from idea to production and take responsibility for outcomes.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Java or Go, writing production backend services.
* Solid foundation in distributed systems, microservices, and API design (gRPC and/or REST).
* Experience with databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, CockroachDB) and writing performant queries.
* Experience designing data models and core domain objects that other teams build on top of.
* Experience operating services in production, and a collaborative, product-minded approach.

**Nice to Have**

* Workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal, Cadence) or event-driven architectures (Kafka).
* Authentication, authorization, permissions, or entitlements systems.
* Experience with API modernization or migrating services off a legacy stack.
* Marketplace, merchant platform, subscription, or billing systems experience.
* Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).

**Why join us**

* Demand for online food delivery is growing really fast! In the last 5 years, just in the US, the overall market has expanded 10X from $10B to $100B, and could expand to $500bn-$1T by 2030.
* Changing the restaurant industry: You'll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
* Collaborative environment: You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you'll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer's success.

**What Else You Need To Know**
This role is based in our Mountain View office location. As a company driven by innovation and continuous change, close collaboration is essential. We're constantly reimagining our industry, creating new products, and refining our processes, and we do our best work together. That's why all of our office-based teams work onsite, five days a week.

**Job Description**
**What We Do**
At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Drive new businesses, redefine finance using AI, and seize opportunities at market speed.
  
  
In an era defined by AI, Engineering isn't just central – it's the driving force behind our business. Our dynamic environment demands innovative strategic thinking and immediate, impactful solutions. Ready to push the limits of digital possibility? Begin your journey here.
  
  
**Who We Look For**
Goldman Sachs Engineers are at the forefront of innovation, driving solutions as creative collaborators in a fast-paced global environment. We seek individuals who evolve, adapt, and thrive on challenging problems.
  
  
As a Front Office Engineer, you will be instrumental in developing cutting-edge software solutions. Your responsibilities will include designing and implementing robust, low-latency systems crucial for pricing, quoting, and hedging a diverse range of financial instruments, such as USTs, Swaps, and MBS. You will also develop innovative platforms that enable efficient risk and P&L management for our trading desks. A key aspect of your role will involve leveraging AI-driven analytics for sophisticated data analysis and to inform predictive pricing strategies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Computer Science (or equivalent work experience).
* Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience using a modern programming language (Java, C/C++, Python).
* Strong analytical skills, ability to quickly identify scope and impact of issues.
* Team oriented mindset with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* Energetic, self-directed, and self-motivated.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Financial Services or Fintech..
* Experience with AWS.
* Experience working on high availability, mission critical systems.
* Experience with microservice architectures (SOA).
* Experience engineering solutions with distributed tracing, performance testing, authentication, authorization
* Experience with UNIX operating systems internals, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and networking.
* Proficiency with algorithms, data structures, and software design.

Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. **About Pelico**
Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.
  
  
We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.
  
  
Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.
  
  
This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.
  
  
**About The Role**
Companies have multiple founding moments and Pelico is going through a new one.
  
  
You would be one of the founding engineers of our new agentic platform, building alongside a small, super talented, high-bar team. This is a hands-on seat from day one: you write the code that manufacturers and their own AI teams build on, close to real customers and real factory data.
  
  
You benefit from company assets (data, events dependency graphs, simulation engine, next best action algorithms) and the reach that comes from Pelico running the operational data of multiple leading manufacturers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Ship agent capabilities end to end. Build real features from the tool/MCP and orchestration backend through to the React console, live for users - not demos.
* Harden the runtime. Durable execution, retries, scheduling, and human-in-the-loop approvals on agent actions that carry real consequences.
* Make agents trustworthy. Grow the eval harness (scenario evals, LLM-as-judge) so we catch regressions in agent behavior before they ship.
* Build a console people believe. Real-time streaming of agent events, tool calls, and approvals - clear, fast, and reliable enough that a controller trusts it.
* Set a craft bar. Write specs others build against, keep the frontend/backend contract honest, and leave reusable patterns the team adopts.

**About You**
We care about how good you are and how far you can go, and we calibrate to the experience you bring. This seat is built for exceptional people - whether you are just out of a top program or already have a few years of serious building behind you.
  
  

* An excellent engineer who ships. You write excellent code and have built real things, full-stack across a Python backend and a React frontend - or you are clearly able to get there fast.
* Hungry and driven. You want a hard problem to own, not a comfortable seat, and you have the ceiling to grow into far more.
* Rigorous with non-deterministic systems. You spec and eval before shipping, trust evidence over vibes, and own what goes out - including AI-assisted code - following problems into production.
* AI-native and curious. You understand how agent frameworks, tools, and evals actually work under the hood, and you build with AI coding tools every day.
* Calm in fast-moving ambiguity. You stay effective on a stack where this quarter's best practice changes next quarter, turning uncertainty into a workable plan.

*Nice to have: real AI/agent product experience (MCP, agent frameworks, evals); durable workflow engines (e.g. Temporal); streaming UIs; observability (OpenTelemetry); spec-driven development; multi-tenant SaaS, or aerospace/defense/discrete-manufacturing context.*
**Why Pelico**
If You Want To Build Something Hard From The Ground Up, With Real Ownership From Day One, This Is The Seat. What Comes With It
  
  

* A founding team and a real mandate. You help build Condor from its early days, with genuine ownership of what you ship and room to grow fast.
* The highest-stakes work you could take on. You build for some of the largest manufacturers, at the scale of their global operations, on a moat competitors cannot copy: we own both the factory simulation and the scoreboard that says whether an agent actually helped.
* A small, elite, AI-native team. Be challenged by strong peers, learn quickly, and ship fast.
* Competitive salary benchmarked to your market, plus health, dental, and vision coverage and a learning budget.

*Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.*
